recommendations: Brendan O'Bra “As Ian's FIRST Robotics programming mentor, I have had the unique pleasure and privilege of getting to watch Ian grow from an incredibly bright 9th grader who showed up ready to code++ to a young adult that *I* continue to learn from. As you can see from his (already) quite accomplished LinkedIn Profile, he is a man of many talents and interests, and does ALL of them well. Ian possesses an incredibly unique combination of intellect, curiosity and intense drive that motivates him to solve even the most intractable problems. He has been instrumental in taking our little team to entirely new levels and managed to accomplish the "mentor wish list" that I have had for 9 years of things like swerve drive, full autonomous, accurate scoring, field relative odometry (with vision in the loop : ) ), PID implementations for many critical subsystems and many more features (I could go on and on...). that are generally considered out of reach for all but elite FRC teams. On top of all that , Ian is well rounded guy, with many interests beyond technology, with an excellent sense of humor. I am looking forward to whatever amazing things Ian does next, and what his impact on the world will be - I am confident whatever it is will be remarkable.”
